address: 325 rue de La Couronne, Québec, G1K 6E7, Canada
bio: In this rustic-style decor, your gaze is immediately drawn to the bar. The cocktails are shaken up at incredible speed and a carefully chosen playlist provides background music. Gracing the menu in this Indian atmosphere, there are a few authentic dishes, such as delicious crispy pakoras, tasty pork belly vindaloo, and hearty dal that warms the soul. As for the chapatis, they are so exquisite that you feel you could easily order a whole stack of them! Reservations are required....
